snippet.title: sins of KALEIDO  Nintendo Switch™ - Opening Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest from AmuLit! Check out the opening movie for sins of KALEIDO, an upcoming download-exclusive game for the Nintendo Switch™!!

✧••┈┈💎STORY💎┈┈••✧

"This is my will. No one else's."

She was once the beloved child of a wealthy family.
But those bright days were swallowed by the darkness of a tragic scheme.

Having lost everything, the girl returns to her homeland with ambition burning in her heart.
There, she meets a group of heretical men who harbor the power of witches.

Bonds forged by wounded souls
Warmth flickering in frozen hearts
The miracle of love, now known by the lonesome

But in the end...

Death is but a turning point. Hope is the prelude to despair.

This is the story of saving those vanishing fates.

✧••┈┈┈┈••✧••┈┈┈┈••✧

"Hearts, sins, despair... Gather them all."

◆Nintendo eShop◆
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sins-of-kaleido-switch/

◆X (Twitter)◆
sins of KALEIDO: https://x.com/sinsofKALEIDO
AmuLit: https://x.com/AmuLit_Global

◆Official Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english

◆Official Portal Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/switch/english/

◆Cast◆
Nobuhiko Okamoto / Kohei Amasaki / Hikaru Midorikawa / Takuya Sato / Tomoaki Maeno

Syun Horie / Yuhko Kaida / Sakura Kasuga / Juri Nagatsuma / Kouichi Souma / Yasunori Masutani / Hitomi Ueda / Masaya Fukunishi / Hinako Takahashi / Takuya Masumoto / Takuya Tsuda / Isshin  Chiba

◆Participating Creators◆
Director/Scenario: Ayane Ushio
Illustrator: Tana Khaki
Chibi Character Designs: Megumi Mizutani
Background Art: Shizui fen
Soundtrack: Hayato Asano
Theme Song: DUSTCELL "Gimme That!"
Development/UI: UNICO INC.

――――――――――――――

*AmuLit is Voltage Inc's new brand for console platforms.
*sins of KALEIDO is the official title for Project Code Kaleidotower, announced in 2023.
